root_cause: Obligation Terminal Closure PR #4697 failed after correctly verifying production migration because its supersession walk rejected any SQL path on retired unmerged PR #4686, even when that exact path was already delivered by merged #4697 and retained on protected main.

evidence.step: Derive exact Supabase production migration identities across supersession lineage

fix: At terminal supersession traversal, permit only exact migration filenames already collected from the merged successor with the same obligation and simultaneously present on protected main; all other retired SQL migration paths stay fail-closed. Keep existing provider migration readback unchanged.
prevention_rule: Compare retired SQL paths to delivered exact merged successor path AND protected main before skipping. Never equate closed/unmerged with deployed, never infer production validity from filename alone; require final Supabase migration/version provider readback and terminal workflow gates.
